question: What is the average forecasted annual sales for products 4160 and 7790 during 2018, using monthly sales data starting from January 2016 for the first 36 months, applying seasonality adjustments from time steps 7 through 30, and employing a weighted regression method to estimate sales?
sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT 
    product_id,
    TRY_CAST(mth AS DATE) as month_date,
    qty,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY TRY_CAST(mth AS DATE)) as time_step,
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TRY_CAST(mth AS DATE)) as month_of_year
  FROM monthly_sales
  WHERE product_id IN (4160, 7790)
),
params AS (
  SELECT 
    product_id,
    time_step,
    qty,
    month_of_year
  FROM base
),
seasonal_factors AS (
  SELECT 
    product_id,
    month_of_year,
    AVG(qty) as seasonal_factor
  FROM params
  WHERE time_step BETWEEN 7 AND 30
  GROUP BY product_id, month_of_year
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(seasonal_factor) as avg_val FROM seasonal_factors
),
seasonal_indices AS (
  SELECT 
    sf.product_id,
    sf.month_of_year,
    sf.seasonal_factor / o.avg_val as seasonal_index
  FROM seasonal_factors sf
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg o
),
means AS (
  SELECT 
    product_id,
    AVG(time_step * qty) / AVG(time_step) as y_bar_w,
    AVG(time_step * time_step) / AVG(time_step) as x_bar_w
  FROM params
  GROUP BY product_id
),
slope AS (
  SELECT 
    p.product_id,
    SUM(p.time_step * (p.time_step - m.x_bar_w) * (p.qty - m.y_bar_w)) / SUM(p.time_step * (p.time_step - m.x_bar_w) * (p.time_step - m.x_bar_w)) as slope
  FROM params p
  JOIN means m ON p.product_id = m.product_id
  GROUP BY p.product_id
),
forecast AS (
  SELECT 
    p.product_id,
    p.time_step,
    p.month_of_year,
    s.slope,
    m.y_bar_w - s.slope * m.x_bar_w as intercept,
    (m.y_bar_w - s.slope * m.x_bar_w) + s.slope * p.time_step as trend_forecast,
    si.seasonal_index
  FROM params p
  JOIN slope s ON p.product_id = s.product_id
  JOIN means m ON p.product_id = m.product_id
  JOIN seasonal_indices si ON p.product_id = si.product_id AND p.month_of_year = si.month_of_year
  WHERE p.time_step >= 25 AND p.time_step <= 36
)
SELECT 
  product_id,
  time_step,
  month_of_year,
  trend_forecast,
  seasonal_index,
  trend_forecast * seasonal_index as adjusted_forecast
FROM forecast
ORDER BY product_id, time_step
